scope: 100 kHz periodic differential-tensor comparison for a 2 mm MnZn two-slope plate, mu_initial 2500, saturation polarization 0.45 T. Not measured frequency-dependent material data.
unchanged_reactive_gate: max(0.001, 5% of the added reactive factor), applied separately to both spatial phases
conclusion: Increasing source strips and independently halving FEMM mesh size do not demonstrate convergence of the low-effect reactive comparison. The half-mesh loss comparison improves, but does not rescue the failed reactive gate. No model constant or tolerance was changed.
